description:
Create editable Arabic motion graphic designs for offers, announcements and social posts. Browse real templates, fill their text and colors, then open your personalized design in 3aqel to preview, edit and request export. Creating a design is free and does not require an account. Shareable design links expire after seven days; the chat tool does not render video or send email.

For voiceovers, connect your existing 3aqel account, choose a catalogue voice and Arabic dialect, approve a script of up to 500 characters, and retrieve the finished audio. Voice generation uses your available account allowance. Dialect delivery can vary.
